intro: Finding financial support as a high school senior in Vermont can significantly ease the path to further education. This catalog features 9 scholarships specifically for students in your situation, with award amounts ranging from approximately $1,000 to $17,000. Each listing has varying deadlines and requirements, so it's essential to review them closely to identify the best opportunities for your needs.

faq.answer: There are currently 9 scholarships listed for high school seniors in Vermont, covering categories such as community, education, miscellaneous, and STEM. Each scholarship may have different eligibility criteria and focus areas, so it's beneficial to review the details of each listing.
